title: Adopt the evolution without breaking existing Sagas
statement: As a Change Saga maintainer, I can adopt the new report-container capabilities explicitly while existing report and slide-native artifacts remain readable and predictable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The next report container declares version 5 because version 4 remains the distinct slide-native format.
New readers continue to read canonical v2 reports, v3 living and hybrid reports, and standalone v4 slide-native Sagas without changing their semantics.
Upgrade to v5 is explicit, dry-runnable, atomic, and never invents design links, tests, exceptions, or evidence.
Older readers reject v5 with a clear unsupported-version error rather than partially interpreting new reserved roots.
Existing query API v1 response shapes remain compatible while typed expanded paths and coverage states are exposed through API v2.
Downgrade is allowed only when no v5-only quality, exception, policy, or relation records would be discarded.
